name: Servo Cycler
introduction: Servo tester by ABRC: cycles servos end to end (1-999 cycles, 30 cycles/min) with smooth motion and live temperature, current and RX voltage. Read the manual and DISCLAIMER.txt: use only in a separate test model.

releaseNotes.content:
## 1.8.8
- First public release
- Installation and user manual (ServoCycler-Manual-v1.8.8.pdf)
- Disclaimer and safety notes (DISCLAIMER.txt), MIT license
- Smooth motion at 30 cycles/min via Slow up/down 0.5 s, full travel
- Pot 2 = number of cycles, pot 1 = travel
- Dashboard with progress bar, servo-arm cycle dial, temperature bars, current and RX voltage
- Model pictures for X20, X18 / Twin, X14, X10 / X12S
